dedupe_keys.name: multi objective production scheduling and demand forecasting dataset

description: The deposit's creators, listed as Niki, M. Ahari and Shirouyehzad, publish code and data for textile-production scheduling with demand forecasting and substitute production. Separate GAMS text files describe the baseline and developed optimisation formulations. The release also contains forecasting data and implementations labelled NSGA-II and BEO in RAR archives. These files support reproduction and extension of the study's scheduling experiments. Zenodo makes the November 2025 deposit freely available under CC BY 4.0. The landing page does not identify the factory, historical demand period, time-step resolution or detailed machine constraints, so their coverage remains unknown without the internal documentation. GAMS and solver availability are separate from the deposit's licence. The package can inform industrial-capacity and scheduling models, but the code was not executed. No related catalogue record is explicitly identified.
